results.title: CNES Seeks Partners to Mass-Produce Compact Optical Telescopes
results.summary:
The French space agency CNES is looking for an industrial partner to develop and qualify a compact optical telescope for future satellite constellations. The agency says the design must be suitable for mass production, with production volumes exceeding 1,000 units.
